notes.title: Thank you to all those who have played Tits and Shadows.
notes.notes:
Thank you to all those who have played Tits and Shadows.

Before getting sentimental, I would like to share the patch notes with you:

THE FAST TRAVEL HAS DIED! Well, almost.
Previously, the golden statues allowed for quick travel between them from the beginning of the game. Now, it will be necessary to first activate all 4 statues to be able to do this. Why has this decision been made?
In this patch, when a new main or secondary character joins your group, they will automatically be adjusted to Hero's level to prevent hours of experience farming and potentially not wanting to use a character just because you have others at a higher level. But this accelerates the game too much, so I have removed fast travel until later in the game so that the player can familiarize themselves with the map, which is designed to have shortcuts in every corner. If we think about it objectively, the T&S map is a huge cross. This will also encourage interactions with Octavio to restock healing items.

The following characters have been modified to learn one skill each time they level up:

[list]
[*] Hero
[*] Bec Santus
[*] Wendy Woods
[*] Cherry Baba
[*] Lisa
[*] Gabriel
[*] Minerva Cos
[*] Vincent
[*] Victoria
[/list]

This means that their skill trees have been reduced with the intention of focusing them more on specific roles. For example, now Gabriel is more focused on healing, while Lisa is focused on inflicting status ailments on enemies. To solve the new limitation on magic abilities, books will now allow users to add 2 types of elemental magic. Also, now Vanessa will also be in the church once the library is opened, selling books!

[b]New home screen with Victoria as the star.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/eb39908ea05fc3a2f9cb5a22d53eaaab660f5ffc.jpg[/img]

Thank you all!
I take this opportunity to thank all those who buy and play Tits and Shadows. Although it is still far from what I want, it warms my heart to see people dedicating time to side quests, hunting achievements, and finding secrets that I scattered throughout the map. Many things have happened in this time and many things have changed since T&S saw the light on Steam. I hope to continue creating an experience that you can enjoy as something enjoyable and entertaining. notes.title: Tits and Shadows: Combat Evolved
notes.notes:
Tits and Shadows: Combat Evolved

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/564bb4f5c728c4a20367539beddef779e328d7e8.png[/img]

This update marks a turning point in the evolution of turn-based combat in Tits and Shadows. I am pleased to announce that we have balanced the turn distribution and made adjustments to ability cooldowns. Look forward to more items that will empower your companions in future updates!

Gloves have undergone changes and now offer various benefits, some of which will only unlock as you progress in the game.

To compensate for channeling time, G and EX abilities now inflict more damage.

A significant change is the revision of the counterattack system to prevent the "Scope not found" error. Now, the character who counterattacks will receive damage before executing their counterattack, so increasing defenses is recommended.

All enemies must now channel to use powerful abilities, allowing you to anticipate strong attacks.

Significant changes have been made to unique abilities. For example, "Fly" now allows you to use powerful G abilities but blocks EX abilities, making Gabriel a more valuable character on your team.

The names and descriptions of many weapons have changed almost completely, including their attributes, to make it easier to choose the right weapon.

The ATB system has been officially discontinued, so please make necessary changes while the option is still available in the trophy room.

I'm excited because combat in Tits and Shadows now feels more original. I look forward to your feedback, and remember that any suggestions are welcome. We may still need to refine some details.

In the next update, boss battles will be improved.

-Luis de LuQui

notes.title: Tits and Shadows: Enhanced Combat Update
notes.notes:
Tits and Shadows: Enhanced Combat Update

This update is crucial! I'm pleased to share that we've made significant changes to the entire turn-based combat system. Now, to use powerful abilities, it's necessary to channel them, which will require a full turn. Both players and enemies will be subject to this limitation.

Abilities like Swiftness, Delay, and Interruption now function within our Active Time Battle (ATB) combat system. For existing players, if your character has reached level 10, you'll be able to learn the "Channel" ability, which will grant you access to this enhancement. However, if you haven't reached level 10 yet, don't worry and continue your journey. For new players, the ability will be learned automatically.

What does this mean for those playing using ATB? Honestly, the future of ATB isn't very promising. It seems that most players don't enjoy this mode of play, so it will be removed in upcoming updates. Please switch your play style to classic while you still have the chance.

Altered States:

We've also made updates to altered states, significantly reducing their quantity. Now, unstable states prohibit channeling, and states that limit the player's actions are more likely to be removed when the player takes damage.

This is a significant update. While I haven't been able to update all weapon descriptions and names yet, my priority is to ensure that combat functions as it should. Please report any errors with the functioning of this patch.

notes.title: Tits and Shadows: Stores and More Update
notes.notes:
Tits and Shadows: Stores and More Update

Greetings, dear players! We are pleased to present to you the latest update, primarily focused on improvements to the stores. We now have specialized vendors offering a unique variety of goods.

Store Changes:
For instance, Catherine now specializes in selling a wide range of plants and mushroom jelly. Meanwhile, in the Slime Cave, you will find everything related to minerals. We invite you to explore the stores to discover the exciting new offerings.

New EXP Potion:
Introducing the EXP Potion, a valuable elixir that allows your DLC allies or others to quickly reach the maximum level. Although it is an expensive item, you can also craft it with the help of our dear Darky. The recipe will unlock upon defeating Putana.

Enemy Pursuit Enhancements:
We have significantly reduced the time it takes for enemies to initiate pursuits, so now you must exercise caution when passing near their line of sight. The excitement and challenge have been intensified.

Increased Quartz Ore Drops:
We acknowledge the importance of quartz, and we understand that previous ore yields were insufficient. We have considerably increased the amount of quartz obtained from mining, making the experience much more rewarding.

New Enemy: Bloodsucker:
In the mysterious swamp cave, a new challenge has been added: the Bloodsucker. This resilient creature has a sole purpose to disable members of your team. It is recommended to stun or eliminate it quickly.

New NPCs in Putan Castle:
With the arrival at Putan Castle, we have introduced new inhabitants. The werewolf brothers Athos, Portos, and Ariamis are the first NPCs to establish themselves in the castle.

We hope you enjoy these exciting updates and continue your adventure in Tits and Shadows!

notes.title: Tits and Shadows Update: Wild Beasts
notes.notes:
Tits and Shadows Update: Wild Beasts

Greetings, dear players! This update was a creative challenge. With improvements in armor and a reduction in enemies, the game became too easy. Battles with creatures like wolves, bats, eagles, and jaguars became annoyingly simple. To completely change the dynamics of facing these enemies, the game's beasts have shifted their approach to battle.

Now, these creatures specialize in inducing status effects in the player's group. Dealing with them, whether stunning or silencing, might be your best option. Furthermore, the effects of player's stun and other altered states abilities have been changed. Now, the most powerful version of these skills will be an area-of-effect attack capable of causing altered states to the entire enemy team. Prepare to face the Wild Beasts and discover new strategies to survive!

We hope you enjoy these enhancements and continue to relish your experience in Tits and Shadows! Get ready for new thrills and challenges on your journey through this fascinating world!

notes.title: Tits and Shadows Update : Armors and Enemies.

Although this update may be smaller in size, its impact is significant. It primarily focuses on armor improvements. Here are the key changes:

Heavy Armor:

Magical resistance of Heavy Armor has been significantly improved.
It now grants a greater amount of life to the user, providing a stronger defense on the battlefield.
General Armor:

This armor now increases the experience (EXP) gained by its users.
A beneficial addition for those looking to level up their alternative characters that have fallen behind.
Enemy AI Enhancement:

The skills of many enemies have been adjusted to strategically target characters on your team with higher life.
This change aims to prevent all enemies from focusing solely on those with better physical or magical defense, providing a more equitable approach in battles.

I appreciate your patience and ongoing support as we work to enhance the Tits and Shadows experience. May these changes make battles feel more challenging and fair! Get ready for the next adventure in the world of Tits and Shadows!

In this week's update, we have increased the resilience of all enemies. Now, enemies will have a consistent life level across all difficulties. With this enhancement, we aim to add a touch of excitement to the battles for those who enjoy the normal mode. Additionally, we've introduced predefined events in two boss encounters, the Wendigo and the Alpha Wolf, aiming to make them more unique without overly increasing their difficulty, as these encounters happen at the beginning of the game.

Finally, we've implemented the ability to rest in all beds in caves and NPC houses. Sleeping will allow you to restore your health and revive all your companions. This addresses an annoying issue where character dialogues were cut off and difficult to follow. Now, you can enjoy uninterrupted conversations without visual interruptions.

Hero Mode Combat Balance

We've invested time and effort into refining and balancing the Hero Mode, which offers a challenging combat experience, sometimes even demanding. We want to ensure that your encounters with enemies are exciting and rewarding, yet not unfair. We've thoroughly tested each battle in this mode and made adjustments to achieve optimal balance. Hero Mode is particularly recommended for players who have completed the game in normal mode at least once.

Enhanced World Drops: A World of Rewards

We've taken your suggestions into account and amplified the excitement of exploring every corner of the 'Tits and Shadows' world. Now, when you discover hidden chests and treasures, the rewards will be even more thrilling. We've improved the quality of weapons and armor you can uncover, making each chest a significant incentive for delving deep into exploration.

General Programming Improvement: Efficiency and Optimization

Your experience's quality is our priority, so we've worked on enhancing the game's general programming. We've identified processes that unnecessarily consumed resources during gameplay and opted for alternative solutions that yield the same results. This not only contributes to smoother performance but also ensures that you can enjoy 'Tits and Shadows' optimally.

Map Enhancement: A World in Constant Evolution

We've heard your feedback regarding navigation in certain outdoor maps and have decided to give them a special touch. Some maps have been updated and enhanced to work more smoothly with the enemy pursuit system. We want your gameplay experience to be as immersive and engaging as possible, and these adjustments contribute to achieving that.

Complete Base Experience: Proud of Our Achievements

While we continue to plan for more exciting content and features in the future, we're immensely proud of what we've accomplished so far. We hope you immerse yourself in this world of epic fantasy and enjoy every aspect of the adventure we've crafted for you.

- We have completely revamped the combat interface! We hope it's more aesthetic and allows you to have a clearer view of the battlefield. Let every battle be epic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/c8b406714c0f4f3bf88ecb89ea5fbdc23a3a0908.jpg[/img]

- Oh, and something important: enemies now scale their level with the player! So, don't let your guard down even if you reach the maximum level! Low-level encounters will still be a threat and keep you alert.

- Additionally, we have added animations to status effects! We want to provide a more immersive gaming experience, and these animations will help you remember if you are affected by any negative status.

- As we explored the depths of the code, we found an error with enemies that have double turns, so we have temporarily removed them. But don't worry, we are working to bring them back soon, and maybe with some additional surprises.

- We have also organized skills into categories to make the menu easier to navigate. We don't want you to miss any powerful spells or abilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/565f7761e9227b75033dba0d87f6459c28583543.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/5109e4afb4d2cfc679f3a055e9d37388392341dd.jpg[/img]

But beware! If you are already immersed in the adventure and notice that you don't have access to any skills, remember to deactivate the god mode, even if it's not activated, so your characters return to their base stats, and the skills become available again. We don't want you to be powerless!

Oh, and we have exciting plans for the future! We are working on implementing a "Skill Shop," where you can expand the magical and skill catalog of your characters. More options, more power, more fun!

- And that's not all! We have added new skills and status effects for some enemies. Get ready to face new challenges and strategies.

- Moreover, enemies now have a higher chance of dropping usable items upon defeat. So be sure to check the treasures they leave behind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/1b69ed85742a9a74d6527b2e7f8091b2acb01fbe.jpg[/img]

Now, when facing enemies, you'll know their weaknesses. That's right! If you attack them with an element they are weak against, they'll let you know. But that's not all; the information will be recorded below their name, so you won't forget!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/a9b88d768f7dc60bcb1e8557611aec05c1ca1e5f.jpg[/img]

Do you want to have the upper hand in battles? No problem! We've added the "Revealing Lens," a magical tool that will show you the enemies' weaknesses without the need to guess. A true ace up your sleeve!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/730c0d972eaf8f13845a2d4684c3560a748833cf.jpg[/img]

- Of course, in the process of improvements, we have also fixed some pesky bugs. We've resolved the bug that prevented you from leaving the right side of the pyramid in the Mictlán update, and we've adjusted some collisions in the frozen mountain. We've also properly aligned the English text. And, oh, we've removed a skill with a code name that definitely shouldn't have been in Hero's repertoire!

Finally, there's a small inconvenience that we are still investigating. When loading an old save file in the first few seconds of the game, the cemetery map is displayed. We are working hard to find a definitive solution!

As always, we deeply appreciate your support and feedback. We are open to complaints, suggestions, and bug reports. Our mission is to make Tits and Shadows an unforgettable gaming experience for all of you.

We wish you an excellent week full of adventures and excitement in our incredible fantasy world!

ATT - Luis de LuQui

notes.title: Tits and shadows V1.1 Active Time Battle System

I am pleased to announce to all our players that we have made significant changes to the battle system of Tits and Shadows V1.1: Active Time Battle! Although it is still menu-based, the player will now be more immersed and attentive to each of their actions.

The Active Time Battle system rewards critical thinking and exploiting the enemy's weaknesses.

To incorporate this new update into your game, please follow these steps:

[list]
[*] Talk to Erinn in the trophy room.
[*] Request to reset all your characters with the new abilities, even if you don't have God mode activated.
[*] Additionally, to not spoil anyone's experience, you are allowed to take an experience boost that will raise the level of all your characters to the maximum when resetting their stats.
[/list]


New players do not need to perform any of the above actions as the new system is enabled by default.

We have placed a Skullie in the trophy room so you can watch the tutorial if necessary and address any questions. Enjoy the exciting Active Time Battle in Tits and Shadows V1.1!

We appreciate your feedback and would like to remind you that we are still working on making necessary balance adjustments in the game. We greatly value your opinions and suggestions as they help us improve the experience for all players.

Additionally, you can adjust the combat system speed in the Options menu to suit your gameplay style. Personally, I have it set to speed 1.

Please feel free to share any additional comments you may have. Your feedback is important to us, and we are committed to making this game an exciting and balanced experience for everyone. Thank you for your support and collaboration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/25d13823e0e16b44d470cce3851729445efd1575.png[/img]

We are pleased to present the first Steam update, version 1.01. Here's a brief summary of the introduced features, but not limited to:

New Story:
Strange creatures have emerged from the caves and are planning to destroy everything! It's your task to put an end to their expedition. In this update, we have added a new area with 2 completely new enemies and new accessories that expand the possibilities for your favorite characters. We have also introduced a new character, Andromeda. We can't wait for you to meet her!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/4064e4a3b22cb521a566602531f84eb204abeef2.png[/img]

We are also excited to announce our collaboration with the Spanish game review channel, Frames Laveth. We are immensely grateful for their participation in Tits and Shadows. You can find more information on the YouTube channel "[url=https://www.youtube.com/@elframeshablandoweas3864]El Frames hablando weas[/url]."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/cd4c55ac7b071f56062561b78d6d148d834b2300.png[/img]

[b]Combat Balance:[/b]
In this update, we have made significant changes to accessories and their interaction with players. The accessories sold by Iris, the blacksmith, now enhance all player attributes, while Nick's artisan stones provide more specific improvements. We have also created new accessories that can completely turn the tide of battle in favor of the player. Additionally, some characters now have a higher chance of inflicting status ailments on enemies. We hope this combat update makes the game more enjoyable and balanced for all of you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/5090304710b4c71489691337c35077b408744bcb.png[/img]

[b]The Air Balloon:[/b]
In Tits and Shadows, we strive to design levels with as few "dead" areas as possible. However, we acknowledge that some parts of the game can become tedious to traverse. To address this, we have decided to introduce the Air Balloon as a new means of transportation. It will be available only to those who have defeated Putana and wish to complete side or optional quests. We believe this addition will be incredibly fun.

Important Note: For players using save data from before this update, we have identified an issue where the balloon overlaps with the environment. Although it can be annoying, we haven't found a solution for this problem yet.

[b]Micro Missions:[/b]
From now on, some NPCs and citizens will offer small additional quests that will not be recorded in the mission journal. These missions have been created to give a purpose to the surplus resources that some players may accumulate and, in return, provide experience points.

[b]Extended Gallery:[/b]
We have expanded the gallery to also include the sexy images that players encounter during the game.
[u]Note: Some players may experience a strange corruption in the number of unlocked images.[/u]
[u]We are working on a solution to compensate for this issue.[/u]

[b]Bug Fixes and Crashes:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have fixed some errors in the text displaying the code used for translation. We have also resolved an issue where Lisa's image would remain on the screen

 during one of her sexy scenes.
[*] Additionally, we have fixed a bug that prevented opening a chest in the "Forgotten Wasteland."
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update and we appreciate your continued support.
Have fun playing!
